parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_contacts (contact_id text PRIMARY KEY, company_id text, name text, email text, phone text, primary_channel text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_contact_channels (contact_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES copiloto_contacts(contact_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, channel text NOT NULL, external_sender_id text NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY(channel, external_sender_id), UNIQUE(contact_id, channel)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_opportunities (opportunity_id text PRIMARY KEY, contact_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES copiloto_contacts(contact_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', intent text, lead_temperature text, product_interest text, need text, motivation text, objections jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, buying_signals jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, missing_information jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, next_action text, action_type text, confidence numeric, assigned_to text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_event_occurred_at timestamptz); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_events (event_id text PRIMARY KEY, channel text NOT NULL, external_message_id text NOT NULL, sender_id text, contact_id text, opportunity_id text, event_type text NOT NULL, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL, received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), text text, UNIQUE(channel, external_message_id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS copiloto_message_results (event_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES copiloto_events(event_id), opportunity_id text, action_type text, auto_respond boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, delivery_status text, provider_message_id text, handoff_required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, processed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cc_events_contact_time ON copiloto_events(contact_id, occurred_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cc_opp_contact_time ON copiloto_opportunities(contact_id, updated_at DESC);

WITH input AS (SELECT {{JSON.stringify($json.event_input.channel)}}::text channel,{{JSON.stringify($json.event_input.external_message_id)}}::text external_message_id,{{JSON.stringify($json.event_input.sender_id)}}::text sender_id,{{JSON.stringify($json.event_input.text)}}::text text,COALESCE(NULLIF({{JSON.stringify($json.event_input.occurred_at)}}::text,'null'),now()::text)::timestamptz occurred_at,NULLIF({{JSON.stringify($json.event_input.company_id)}}::text,'null') company_id),evt AS (INSERT INTO copiloto_events(event_id,channel,external_message_id,sender_id,event_type,occurred_at,text) SELECT 'evt-'||channel||'-'||external_message_id,channel,external_message_id,sender_id,'message_received',occurred_at,text FROM input ON CONFLICT(channel,external_message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING *),existing_evt AS (SELECT e.* FROM copiloto_events e JOIN input i ON e.channel=i.channel AND e.external_message_id=i.external_message_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evt)),contact_existing AS (SELECT c.* FROM copiloto_contacts c JOIN copiloto_contact_channels cc ON cc.contact_id=c.contact_id JOIN input i ON cc.channel=i.channel AND cc.external_sender_id=i.sender_id),contact_new AS (INSERT INTO copiloto_contacts(contact_id,company_id,primary_channel) SELECT 'contact-'||substr(md5(channel||':'||sender_id),1,20),company_id,channel FROM input WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contact_existing) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evt) RETURNING *),contact AS (SELECT * FROM contact_existing UNION ALL SELECT * FROM contact_new),channel_link AS (INSERT INTO copiloto_contact_channels(contact_id,channel,external_sender_id) SELECT contact_id,(SELECT channel FROM input),(SELECT sender_id FROM input) FROM contact ON CONFLICT(channel,external_sender_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now() RETURNING *),active_opp AS (SELECT o.* FROM copiloto_opportunities o JOIN contact c ON c.contact_id=o.contact_id WHERE o.stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') ORDER BY o.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1),new_opp AS (INSERT INTO copiloto_opportunities(opportunity_id,contact_id,stage) SELECT 'opp-'||c.contact_id||'-'||substr(md5(random()::text),1,10),c.contact_id,'new' FROM contact c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_opp) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evt) RETURNING *),chosen_opp AS (SELECT * FROM active_opp UNION ALL SELECT * FROM new_opp),link_evt AS (UPDATE copiloto_events e SET contact_id=c.contact_id,opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id FROM contact c,chosen_opp o,input i WHERE e.event_id='evt-'||i.channel||'-'||i.external_message_id RETURNING e.*) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM existing_evt) THEN 'duplicate' ELSE 'continue' END route,COALESCE((SELECT event_id FROM existing_evt),(SELECT event_id FROM evt)) event_id,COALESCE((SELECT contact_id FROM existing_evt),(SELECT contact_id FROM link_evt),(SELECT contact_id FROM chosen_opp)) contact_id,COALESCE((SELECT opportunity_id FROM existing_evt),(SELECT opportunity_id FROM link_evt),(SELECT opportunity_id FROM chosen_opp)) opportunity_id,(SELECT channel FROM input) channel,(SELECT sender_id FROM input) sender_id,(SELECT text FROM input) text,(SELECT occurred_at FROM input) occurred_at,(SELECT stage FROM chosen_opp LIMIT 1) previous_stage;

SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.contact_id,o.stage,o.intent,o.lead_temperature,o.product_interest,o.need,o.motivation,o.objections,o.buying_signals,o.missing_information,o.next_action,o.action_type,o.confidence,o.assigned_to,e.event_id,e.channel,e.sender_id,e.text,e.occurred_at FROM copiloto_opportunities o LEFT JOIN copiloto_events e ON e.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id WHERE o.opportunity_id={{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity_id)}}::text ORDER BY e.occurred_at ASC;

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);const resolver=$('DB — Contact + Opportunity + Deduplicación').first().json;const history=rows.filter(r=>r.event_id).map(r=>({event_id:r.event_id,channel:r.channel,sender_id:r.sender_id,text:r.text,occurred_at:r.occurred_at}));const latest=history.at(-1);const previous=rows[0]||{};return[{json:{route:resolver.route,analysis_input:{event_id:resolver.event_id,channel:latest?.channel||resolver.channel,sender_id:latest?.sender_id||resolver.sender_id,text:latest?.text||resolver.text,occurred_at:latest?.occurred_at||resolver.occurred_at,contact_id:resolver.contact_id,opportunity_id:resolver.opportunity_id,previous_stage:previous.stage||resolver.previous_stage||'new',conversation_history:history.slice(-20)}}}];

const ctx=$('Construir contexto comercial').first().json.analysis_input;const a=$input.first().json;const action=a.action_type||'handoff';const confidence=typeof a.confidence==='number'?a.confidence:0;const safeActions=['respond','ask','recommend','handle_objection','validate_intent','close'];const autoRespond=safeActions.includes(action)&&confidence>=0.70&&Boolean(a.suggested_response?.trim());return[{json:{event:{event_id:ctx.event_id,channel:ctx.channel,sender_id:ctx.sender_id,text:ctx.text,occurred_at:ctx.occurred_at},contact:{contact_id:ctx.contact_id},opportunity:{opportunity_id:ctx.opportunity_id,contact_id:ctx.contact_id,stage:a.sales_stage||ctx.previous_stage||'new',intent:a.intent||null,lead_temperature:a.lead_temperature||null,product_interest:a.product_interest??null,need:a.need??null,motivation:a.motivation??null,objections:a.objections||[],buying_signals:a.buying_signals||[],missing_information:a.missing_information||[],next_action:a.next_action||null,action_type:action,confidence},auto_respond:autoRespond,suggested_response:a.suggested_response||null,handoff:{required:!autoRespond,reason:autoRespond?null:action,status:autoRespond?null:'PENDING_SELLER'}}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO copiloto_opportunities(opportunity_id,contact_id,stage,intent,lead_temperature,product_interest,need,motivation,objections,buying_signals,missing_information,next_action,action_type,confidence,updated_at,last_event_occurred_at) VALUES ({{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.opportunity_id)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.contact_id)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.stage||'new')}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.intent)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.lead_temperature)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.product_interest)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.need)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.motivation)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.objections||[])}}::jsonb,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.buying_signals||[])}}::jsonb,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.missing_information||[])}}::jsonb,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.next_action)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.action_type||'handoff')}}::text,{{Number($json.opportunity.confidence??0)}},now(),COALESCE({{JSON.stringify($json.event.occurred_at)}}::text,now()::text)::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT(opportunity_id) DO UPDATE SET stage=EXCLUDED.stage,intent=EXCLUDED.intent,lead_temperature=EXCLUDED.lead_temperature,product_interest=EXCLUDED.product_interest,need=EXCLUDED.need,motivation=EXCLUDED.motivation,objections=EXCLUDED.objections,buying_signals=EXCLUDED.buying_signals,missing_information=EXCLUDED.missing_information,next_action=EXCLUDED.next_action,action_type=EXCLUDED.action_type,confidence=EXCLUDED.confidence,updated_at=now(),last_event_occurred_at=CASE WHEN copiloto_opportunities.last_event_occurred_at IS NULL OR copiloto_opportunities.last_event_occurred_at<=EXCLUDED.last_event_occurred_at THEN EXCLUDED.last_event_occurred_at ELSE copiloto_opportunities.last_event_occurred_at END; INSERT INTO copiloto_message_results(event_id,opportunity_id,action_type,auto_respond,delivery_status,provider_message_id,handoff_required) VALUES ({{JSON.stringify($json.event.event_id)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.opportunity_id)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.action_type||'handoff')}}::text,{{Boolean($json.auto_respond)}},{{JSON.stringify($json.delivery?.status)}}::text,{{JSON.stringify($json.delivery?.provider_message_id)}}::text,{{Boolean($json.handoff?.required)}}) ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO UPDATE SET action_type=EXCLUDED.action_type,auto_respond=EXCLUDED.auto_respond,delivery_status=EXCLUDED.delivery_status,provider_message_id=EXCLUDED.provider_message_id,handoff_required=EXCLUDED.handoff_required,processed_at=now(); SELECT 200 AS "httpStatus",json_build_object('ok',true,'event_id',{{JSON.stringify($json.event.event_id)}},'opportunity_id',{{JSON.stringify($json.opportunity.opportunity_id)}},'auto_respond',{{Boolean($json.auto_respond)}},'handoff_required',{{Boolean($json.handoff?.required)}},'delivery_status',{{JSON.stringify($json.delivery?.status)}}) AS body;
